_meta._doc: ollie · english strings · editorial voice. literal voice variants live in strings.en.literal.json. all keys must exist in both files.

intro.title: hi.
intro.body: ollie sorts what's in your head into the right places. seven small questions before we start — all skippable.

age.title: what's your age range?
age.sub: just so the copy and defaults fit a bit better. skippable.

country.title: where do you live?
country.sub: so on a hard day i can show the right hotline.

menstr.title: do you track a menstrual cycle?
menstr.sub: if no, the cycle module and cycle-related patterns won't show up at all.

goals.title: what brings you here?
goals.sub: pick anything that resonates · multiple is fine.

confirm.body: write whatever's on your mind into the box below. ollie sorts it. if you're in a crisis, it doesn't go to the pattern engine — a quiet hotline number appears.

consent.title: module consents.
consent.sub: choose what you want to use.

confirmation.grocery_running_low: toilet paper szn approaching. adding to your list.
confirmation.finance_bill_upcoming: ${0} is due in ${1} days. just saying.
confirmation.fallback_no_match: didn't fit anywhere. kept it as a dump.

empty.cycle_cold:
tell me when your last period started.
no pressure on the date — close is enough.
empty.sleep_cold: a few more nights. then this means something.
empty.finance_none: no money in or out yet.
empty.focus_idle: what are you with right now
empty.astrology_no_birth: tell me when and where you were born.

insist.rent_due_today: rent is due in ${0} days. just saying.

crisis.opener_with_name: ${0}, this looks rough. you're not alone.
crisis.opener_no_name: this looks rough. you're not alone.
crisis.close: the dump is here when you're ready.
